description: This file is a shell script used for testing git repository operations involving packing objects with missing bases. It creates a series of git commits and references, sets up clone scenarios, and verifies the behavior of git fetch and clone commands with incomplete repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided commands and verifying their success.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file.

calls: test_write_lines a b c d e f g h i >text
